subject: How to let users save&upload screenshots of their browsers

messages.author: 4b0523047a46ba86
messages.subject: How to let users save&upload screenshots of their browsers
parts:
In Rshiny, is it possible to let users click a "save" button in the browser and save the pictures of the browser to the server? Can I have access to those screenshots and can those screenshots also be made accessible to later users to look at/download? 

Let me know if this question is not specific or confusing, thank you!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to let users save&upload screenshots of their browsers
parts: No, it's not possible. It's not generally possible for a web application to literally take a screenshot of your browser. However, if you're just interested in saving say a plot and the values of your inputs, all the values you need are there on the server (assuming your plotting code is deterministic)--you just need to decide where and how to store/retrieve them.
